sections.body:
**Welcoming FY2026-27 I Naoero Airlines Network:** As we welcome the start of the 2026-2027 financial year, Naoero Airlines proudly continues connecting Brisbane, Naoero, Tarawa, Majuro, Nadi and Suva through our scheduled services, while also operating the services between Tarawa and Kiritimati on behalf of Air Kiribati. Looking ahead, we remain focused on strengthening our operations, enhancing our services, and continuing to connect islands, people and communities across the Pacific, with more connections on the horizon.

To view and download a printable version of our schedules, click on the links below:
